class.name: NNAngleToVector3SearchCriterion
class.brief_description: Filters and scores [Node3D] candidates by the unsigned 3D angle between their forward direction and a vector.
class.description: Compares each [Node3D] candidate's forward direction (-Z) against [member angle_to_direction_vector] using an unsigned 3D angle ([code]0..180[/code] degrees). Use to filter or prefer 3D candidates aligned with a direction. For signed horizontal-only angles, use [NNAngleToVector3XZSearchCriterion].

members.member: Reference 3D direction vector compared against each candidate's forward direction (-Z).
Maximum unsigned angle in degrees (up to [code]180.0[/code]). Maps to [code]1.0[/code] when scoring; angles above it are filtered out when filtering is enabled.
Minimum unsigned angle in degrees. Maps to [code]0.0[/code] when scoring; angles below it are filtered out when filtering is enabled.
